scope: Generate real 3D mesh seed geometry from the approved command-center-concept.png before doing any Blender authoring.

Use Microsoft TRELLIS.2 as the preferred image-to-3D generator. Use an official/local installation or an already-authorized hosted inference endpoint; do not invent credentials or silently substitute another generator.
Attempt whole-scene generation first. If it is visually unusable, crop/segment the same approved reference into coherent architectural clusters and generate multiple seed meshes.
Import generated seed mesh geometry into Blender and use Blender only for cleanup, remesh/decimation, material repair, assembly, scale/origin alignment, protected-anchor fitting and review rendering.
Do not procedurally reconstruct the architecture from primitives. A generated mesh must exist before Blender cleanup begins.
Stop at NEURAL SEED REBUILD — HUMAN VISUAL REVIEW READY. Do not export the production runtime GLB or modify React.
acceptance: The exact primary reference command-center-concept.png is the only visual source authority.
At least one generated mesh seed GLB produced by an image-to-3D model is committed under art/blender/command-center/neural-seed before final Blender cleanup.
neural-seed-provenance.json records reference SHA-256, generator/model, version or commit when available, settings, source crop/full-scene mode, seed GLB SHA-256/bytes and Blender cleanup steps.
The final command-center.blend contains imported/generated mesh seed geometry rather than a fresh primitive procedural reconstruction.
No committed tools/blender authoring script is changed or added for this task.
If whole-scene generation is unusable, any segmented inputs must be crops/derivatives of the same approved reference and be recorded in provenance.
Player spawn, five bridge interfaces, Ask clearance, walkable topology, world scale and runtime camera operating constraints remain unchanged.
The final runtime render materially resembles the reference in silhouette, depth, architectural curvature, facade complexity, material separation, landscape and floating-platform form.
The final scene must not read as a circular plate with perimeter walls and decorative arches.
neural-runtime.png, neural-top.png and neural-side.png are committed for human review.
No React/runtime, topology, CSP, decoder, main or deployment change occurs.
Independent review verifies provenance and protected state; human visual approval remains mandatory before export.
stop_conditions: The trusted feature branch head no longer equals the task base SHA.
The primary reference image is unavailable or unreadable.
No usable image-to-3D compute or already-authorized inference endpoint is available; STOP and report the compute/inference blocker rather than reverting to procedural Blender.
The generator cannot produce any usable mesh seed from either the whole reference or bounded crops/segments of the same reference.
Matching or fitting the generated seed would require moving protected spawn, bridge interfaces, Ask clearance, topology or world scale.
The workflow starts reconstructing the primary architecture from primitive Blender geometry instead of imported generated mesh.
The final render still reads as the same plate/perimeter/arch language after generated-mesh cleanup.
Any path outside the declared write scope changes.
Any production GLB export, React/runtime edit, main change or deployment is attempted.
